text: @dessera/dsh-ultracode 为 DSH Web 客户端提供会话工作流档位。在输入框旁可切换 off、high、ultra，也可用 /ultracode 查看或设置档位。开启后，每个新回合会注入相应的多智能体协作提示：high 安排并行审阅和反驳检查，ultra 扩展探索并要求完整性核查。会话投影同步档位状态。需要会话可见的 workflow 工具，无需额外 API 密钥。

@dessera/dsh-ultracode adds off, high, and ultra workflow levels to DSH Web. Switch in the composer or use /ultracode for status. Armed turns receive multi-agent guidance: high uses parallel review; ultra adds broader exploration and a completeness check. Requires a visible workflow tool.
我想给 DSH 的会话加一个开关，按需启用多智能体工作流。
能不能在输入框旁边切换工作流强度？
让 DSH 每回合自动带上多代理协作的提示。
想要一个命令查看当前会话是否开启了 workflow 模式。
DSH 每次协作都太简单了，怎么切到更深入的多轮分析？
I want a per-session switch for arming a multi-agent workflow in DSH.
Can I choose a more thorough, iterative workflow mode from the composer?
@dessera/dsh-ultracode 的功能「会话档位切换」：在 Web 客户端输入框右侧显示 off、high、ultra 控件。点击后依次切换档位，状态通过会话投影更新；也可用 /ultracode 命令切换或指定档位。
@dessera/dsh-ultracode 的功能「自动注入协作提示」：开启 high 或 ultra 后，在每个合适的新回合开局消息之后注入 workflow 授权横幅和对应指令；没有可见 workflow 工具时不注入开启提示。
@dessera/dsh-ultracode 的功能「分级工作流指引」：high 档提示并行审阅并安排反驳检查；ultra 档要求更广泛的多轮探索、连续无新发现后停止，并进行完整性核查。用户可按任务需要选择档位。
@dessera/dsh-ultracode 的功能「查看会话状态」：运行 /ultracode status 可查看当前档位及 workflow 工具对会话是否可见；命令也支持 off、high、ultra 等档位词。
@dessera/dsh-ultracode 使用前须知：开启档位只有在指定的 workflow 工具对该会话可见时才会注入协作提示；默认工具名为 workflow，可在部署配置中调整。
想把多智能体工具的使用权限限制在明确开启的会话里。
@dessera/dsh-ultracode 提供命令 ultracode：Ultracode session mode: arm automatic multi-agent orchestration.

@dessera/dsh-ultracode README · @dessera/dsh-ultracode：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Ultracode session mode for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). The plugin adds a three-position control to the composer: `off`, `high`, and `ultra`.

@dessera/dsh-ultracode README · Features：- `off` injects nothing, and the session keeps running as DSH ships it. The turn after a level is turned off carries one notice instead.
- `high` and `ultra` arm the session while the workflow tool DSH provides resolves for that session, and every turn the session opens then carries an arming banner that tells the model the turn is authorised for multi-agent orchestration.
- The first turn of a level carries the complete instruction block; every turn after that carries a one-line reminder instead. Turning the level off and arming it again states the block again.
- While a session is armed, the injected text also asks the model to write every `agent()` prompt so that each agent keeps its output brief and hands its material back through files rather than in its reply. The configuration field `conciseSubagentOutput` controls this rule, and it is on by default.

@dessera/dsh-ultracode README · Features：The plugin provides these commands:

| Command             | Meaning                                                                          |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `/ultracode`        | Advances the level                                                               |
| `/ultracode status` | Prints the current level and whether the workflow tool is visible to the session |
@dessera/dsh-ultracode README · Features：> The plugin never changes the model's reasoning effort.
@dessera/dsh-ultracode README · Architecture：The overall architecture of the plugin is in [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md).

@dessera/dsh-ultracode README · Install：Install from npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @dessera/dsh-ultracode
```

Replace `web` with the name of the profile in use.

Install from Git:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Dessera/dsh-ultracode
```

If pnpm reports an ignored build script, add the exact key it printed under `allowBuilds` in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (normally `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/pnpm-workspace.yaml`) and run the same command again.

@dessera/dsh-ultracode README · Build：A build needs:

- Node.js 22.19 or newer within the 22.x line, or Node.js 24 or newer
- pnpm

```sh
corepack pnpm install   # runs the pnpm version pinned in packageManager, installs dependencies and builds
corepack pnpm build     # rebuilds after a source change
corepack pnpm format    # rewrites the files Prettier reports
corepack pnpm check     # the full gate: formatting, lint, typecheck, build, tests

@dessera/dsh-ultracode README · Build：The build writes two artifacts: `lib/index.js` is the host part, which runs in Node inside DSH, and `lib/client.js` is the browser part, which DSH loads into the web client. `corepack pnpm test` runs the tests on their own, and the bundle tests assert against the built `lib/client.js`, so build before testing a change to the client part.

@dessera/dsh-ultracode README · Release：```sh
corepack pnpm check              # the gate passes: formatting, lint, typecheck, build, tests
corepack pnpm version patch      # the version is bumped, and a commit carrying the annotated tag vX.Y.Z is created
git push --follow-tags           # the commit and its tag are pushed to the remote
```

After the run, the package is staged and waits for approval.
